premises.text: Site robots capture detailed 3D maps of the current construction project state
premises.evidence_span: Our robots drive around site, building detailed 3D maps of the environment

premises.text: Cloud software analyzes the maps with registration, optimization, and ML to assess every on-site element
premises.evidence_span: We perform non-rigid registration, nonlinear optimization, machine learning to filter out all the noise and provide precise statistical analysis about every element on site

premises.text: An easy web interface delivers color-coded, searchable, risk-ranked build-quality information to stakeholders
premises.evidence_span: simplified and delivered back to the client on an easy-to-use web-based interface

premises.text: Offered as B2B SaaS that integrates with existing laser scanners and industry-standard file formats
premises.evidence_span: taking this to market on a B2B SaaS model, and we seamlessly integrate with existing workflows, including existing laser scanners

premises.text: Typical clients are multi-billion-euro general contractors onboarded via a single project then expanded organization-wide
premises.evidence_span: Our typical client is a multi-billion euro general contractor. We onboard them with a single project, and then we grow within their organization

value.text: General contractors stay on budget and on schedule by focusing on what puts the project most at risk
value.evidence_span: help you stay on budget and on schedule on your next project

causal_links.evidence_span: This data is then automatically uploaded to our servers in the cloud, where it is analyzed by our software
